mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in the address jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter from an existing banker or lawyer (clearing UBO reputation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution or law firm in the applicant's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered agent or corporate services provider of the shareholder entity

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all beneficial owners, directors, and signatories against: (i) United Nations Consolidated List, (ii) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, (iii) EU and UK global sanctions lists, (iv) Vanuatu domestic sanctions and designations published by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU). PEP status is assessed under the 2020 Act using FATF risk-based approach; enhanced due diligence required for politically exposed persons and any family or close associates. Negative news and adverse media checks are additionally required for all non-resident applicants.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies and Cooperatives Registry, online name reservation and clearance portal (accessible via www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Every International Company name must be in Latin script (English and/or French permitted). Names may be expressed in any language only if romanized/transliterated into Latin characters. The name must include a distinct suffix or equivalent indicating limited liability, such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Société Anonyme' or 'SA'. The name cannot be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name in Vanuatu or any name protected under international conventions.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or the licensed agent receives a written VFSC notice stating the reason. Within 14 days of rejection, a formal appeal letter must be submitted to the VFSC Registrar of International Companies, accompanied by a legal submission distinguishing the proposed name from the conflicting mark and, if applicable, a consent letter from the holder of the existing name or from the relevant ministry for sensitive tokens. The Registrar will adjudicate within 21 working days. If the Registrar denies the appeal, the applicant may file an administrative review application to the Vanuatu Supreme Court under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] within 30 days of the denial notice.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is permitted for an International Company only if a physical registered office in Vanuatu is maintained at the office of a licensed registered agent; a post-office box or non-physical virtual address alone is not acceptable. The registered agent must be a licensed trustee, an attorney, or an accounting firm under VFSC supervision and must hold a valid certificate to provide registered office services.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to Moderate; approximately 8% annual likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection for a non-financial low-risk international company. If the company imports or distributes medical equipment within Vanuatu, the likelihood rises to 15% due to import licensing and Ministry of Health vendor registrations.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, 1992 (as consolidated in the Laws of Vanuatu), sections 4, 8, 10, 15 and 20; Companies Act [Cap 191] for matters not inconsistent
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (international company form adopted by VFSC)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; capital may be expressed in any currency accepted by the subscriber and must be subscribed in accordance with the Memorandum and Articles of Association; no escrow account or capital deposit obligation is required at incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED FIRST: that the subscription by the sole Incorporator of 500 ordinary shares at US$1.00 per share is accepted and such shares are issued as fully paid-up. RESOLVED SECOND: that the registered office situated at Level 3, Fund Centre, Kumul Highway, Port Vila, Vanuatu be and is hereby adopted as the Company's official registered office. RESOLVED THIRD: that the natural persons listed on the consent forms be appointed as first Directors and that the Company Secretary be appointed, each to serve in accordance with the Articles and applicable law, with the Directors authorized to open bank accounts and execute all ancillary documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Availability pre-clearance of proposed corporate name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Name Review Window / Online Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name availability request through the VFSC-licensed registered agent, specifying the desired corporate name and confirming it does not contain restricted words such as 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance' or 'Government'. The VFSC performs a manual search against its index of registered international companies and issued a preliminary non-binding clearance.
required_dossiers: Proposed official name in English (with optional international / trade name)
Name availability search request letter signed by authorised incorporator
Consent from any shareholder or third party if the name includes their name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected or conditioned, submit a revised name request through the same registered agent within 2 business days; no additional fee is charged for the first resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and notarisation of constituent documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent and Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the VFSC prescribed template, incorporating the name, share capital, share classes, shareholder rights, registered office clause and the number of initial directors. All subscribers execute the document before a witness or, if required by the registered agent's internal policy, have execution notarised. The agent obtains signed consents from the intended directors and secretary.
required_dossiers: Consolidated Memorandum and Articles of Association (draft with completed schedules)
Subscriber identification documents (notarised passport copy and proof of address)
Consent to act signed by each director and the secretary
Certificate of incorporation addressing the registered agent as the first registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC later identifies a defective clause, the registered agent will issue supplementary articles and obtain subscriber resolutions to amend the constituent documents before final filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing with VFSC and payment of incorporation fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the physical or electronically lodged incorporation package to the VFSC Companies Registry together with the prescribed government fee of USD 250 (or equivalent in VUV). The VFSC examines the submitted documents for formal compliance with the International Companies Act. Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (final executed version)
Consents to act of directors and secretary
Duly completed VFSC Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
Proof of payment of government filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC raises a filing query or requests further information, the registered agent has 14 calendar days to provide corrections; a re-filing after rejection incurs an additional 50% resubmission fee and requires amended documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation organisational acts and issuance of shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Secretary, VFSC-licensed Registered Agent, and the first Board of Directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receipt of the Certificate of Incorporation, the board holds its first written resolution, appoints the corporate secretary, issues share certificates to the subscriber, adopts a common seal (optional if not required by the Articles), and opens the statutory registers (register of members, directors, secretaries, and registers of charges). The registered agent records the registered office adoption and, where applicable, appoints a local process agent.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution (as approved by the initial directors)
Share certificates in favour of the initial shareholder
Statutory corporate registers (members, directors, secretary, charges)
Consent forms for registered agent and process agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains typographical or clerical errors, the company must apply within 30 days to VFSC on Form IC-3 for rectification; a minor amendment does not affect the validity of the incorporation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) – Business Licence Division, in consultation with the Department of Industry and the Ministry of Health for medical device conformity
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence Certificate (Manufacturing – Medical and Diagnostic Imaging Devices)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 – EIA Registration (Screening) for low-hazard cleanroom manufacturing of radiographic flat panel detectors; full EIA not required unless production involves solvent coating, heavy metal deposition exceeding screening thresholds, or discharge of hazardous process waste
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must conform to the Vanuatu Domestic Trade Effluent Standards and the Waste Management and Pollution Control Act; pH 6–9, biochemical oxygen demand ≤30 mg/L, total suspended solids ≤50 mg/L; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions from any cleaning or deposition process must not exceed 20 mg/m³ at exhaust stack points; all hazardous waste such as caesium iodide or amorphous silicon residues must be classified and disposed of through a DEPC-licensed waste carrier in accordance with the Basel Convention (as adopted by Vanuatu).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service for the premises; structural occupancy certificate issued by the Public Works Department (Building Board) for load tolerance and safe occupancy; workplace safety clearance from the Department of Labour covering radiation shielding, ventilation, clean-up spill protocols, and employee exposure monitoring consistent with ILO standards.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), operating under the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; e-implementation via ASYCUDA World and the Vanuatu Trade Portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned International Companies do not require a domestic Tax Identification Number for income tax purposes because they are statutorily exempt. The entity obtains a certificate of incorporation and a VFSC registration number from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. For customs/export operations, the IC registers as an exporter with the VRCA Customs Division and obtains a VAT registration only if it makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu that exceed VT 3,000,000 per annum or if it opts to register. The physical process: submit Form IC-1 to VFSC, pay government fees, then apply to VRCA for an exporter code via ASYCUDA World.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections exist in Vanuatu. The International Companies Act provides an irrevocable election to convert an IC to a Domestic Company, which subjects it to the standard Vanuatu tax regime. Additionally, any person, including an IC, may voluntarily elect to register for VAT under the VAT Act, notwithstanding its exempt status, provided it satisfies the registration requirements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 249] (as amended), administered by the VRCA.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 3,000,000 (Vanuatu Vatu) of taxable supplies in any 12-month period.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No domestic e-invoicing or fiscal clearance mandate. Export declarations are lodged electronically via ASYCUDA World; no digital stamping or real-time tax authority API clearance applies to VAT invoices. Customs export entries require an approved exporter code and electronic cargo manifest.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods are zero-rated where the exporter proves that the goods were removed from Vanuatu within 28 days of the supply. Services supplied to a non-resident outside Vanuatu and performed outside Vanuatu also qualify for zero-rating. The International Company must retain outward customs declaration, shipping evidence, and payment vouchers. Medical imaging hardware OEM sales to foreign distributors will qualify for the 0% rate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading / House Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate or Bank SWIFT/TT credit advice
Certificate of Origin (if requested by buyer)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: False or fraudulent zero-rating claims are audited by the VRCA Customs/VAT division and may result in a penalty of up to 200% of the tax evaded, interest at the statutory rate, and criminal fines not exceeding VT 5,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 3 years. Input VAT credits may be clawed back retrospectively with a 4-year assessment period. The Commissioner may also require security from exporters suspected of non-compliance. Since the International Company is otherwise tax-exempt, an improper VAT refund claim for exports will trigger revocation of exempt status and liability to the full VAT law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as the national monetary authority and foreign exchange regulator.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a fully liberalised foreign exchange environment. The Vatu is freely convertible for current and capital account transactions; there is no exchange control legislation, no prior RBV approval requirement for profit or capital remittances, and no restriction on foreign ownership or dividend repatriation. The practical hurdle is bank-level documentation and correspondent-bank due diligence, given the small local banking system. The International Company should maintain clear underlying contracts, board resolutions and invoice files to facilitate frictionless settlement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export proceeds surrender obligation in Vanuatu. No mandatory conversion ratio exists, and export receipts may be retained in Vatu or foreign currency accounts at licensed commercial banks without any time-limited surrender requirement. The IC is free to use export proceeds for trade settlements, intra-group payments, or treasury purposes subject only to standard bank record-keeping and AML declarations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (for inward funding) + Operational Account (TT Wire / SWIFT settlements)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BSP Bank (Vanuatu) Limited (Bank of South Pacific)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account + Operational Multi-Currency Account
Operational VUV/USD Account with segregated sub-account for trade settlements
Purely domestic operational account (limited cross-border correspondent strength)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low-Medium. Vanuatu has no dedicated fintech or EMI licensing regime for non-bank payment institutions. Offshore digital EMIs may be used for receivables collection or auxiliary multi-currency settlement, but they cannot legally substitute for a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank as the primary treasury rail. The RBV requires any deposit-taking or payment-system activity to be conducted through a licensed financial institution. The IC should therefore use a licensed commercial bank in Vanuatu as the settlement anchor, with an offshore EMI (e.g., Hong Kong/Singapore-licensed) only as an ancillary collection channel.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Vanuatu licensed banks generally require a physical presence interview for the initial corporate account opening. At least one director or authorised beneficial owner is expected to attend in person at the bank's Port Vila branch (or, in exceptional cases, at a recognised foreign relationship office). Fully remote onboarding is not uniformly accepted. For this IC, a physical visit by the beneficial owner, accompanied by the corporate secretary, is strongly recommended and will materially reduce onboarding time, especially for capital escrow and trade finance facilities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt International Company structure flagged as possible shell or conduit entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission registration extract, Certificate of Incumbency, organisational chart, board resolution confirming business purpose, paid office lease or service agreement, recent bank reference letter, and a detailed commercial business plan covering the ISIC 3250 radiology hardware OEM activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of wealth opacity for capital injection from a foreign shareholder.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements or management accounts of the investing entity, source-of-funds declaration covering the exact wire amount, shareholder's bank confirmation, signed capital contribution resolution, and, where the funds come from a Hong Kong/Singapore entity, a copy of the shareholder's corporate KYC profile.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade payments to OEM suppliers in Singapore/Hong Kong triggering high-value or high-frequency correspondent-bank review.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Purchase orders and pro forma invoices, supplier contracts, shipping and customs documentation (bills of lading, airway bills, packing lists), OEM certificate of origin, proof of product technical assessment, and a projected trade settlement schedule to demonstrate commercial reality.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections will be executed as SWIFT MT103 transfers from the shareholder's corporate account via Hong Kong or Singapore correspondent banks into the IC's VUV or USD operational account at the chosen Vanuatu licensed commercial bank. The beneficiary must be the exact legal name of the International Company. The payment reference must state 'Capital Injection / Equity Contribution' and be supported by a board resolution, proof of registered address, and certificate of incumbency. For any amount exceeding the bank's reporting threshold, the IC must submit an inward remittance advice and source-of-funds declaration. The funds will be parked in a segregated Capital Escrow Account pending verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements will be cleared via SWIFT MT103 for open-account supply payments, and via commercial Letters of Credit (issuing bank: the Vanuatu licensed commercial bank; advising/confirming bank: a Hong Kong or Singapore trade bank) for higher-value OEM transactions. The IC will use Incoterms 2020 (e.g., CIF or CIP) to preserve a clean documentary chain. For imports of digital X-ray detector components, a confirmed irrevocable LC is the preferred rail to mitigate supplier shipping risk, while recurring smaller service payments will be handled through SWIFT MT103 wires.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore FX Forward Contract (VUV/USD or VUV/EUR) executed with an RBV-licensed authorised dealer
Cross-Currency Swap (VUV/USD) under the commercial bank's internal treasury limits
FX spot transaction through a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank for immediate settlement
Zero-Structure Forward Collar (if the bank approves a custom overlay for trade payables)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Registration Renewal and Compliance Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% of the annual fee per month or part thereof; continued default triggers a final notice and administrative strike-off from the Register after 90 days.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent – Annual Declaration of Compliance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Registered Agent (licensed under VFSC) for onward regulatory inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at the same anniversary date, to be submitted by the agent to VFSC
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Agent's license may be sanctioned; the underlying company is designated non-compliant and faces penalty and strike-off if the declaration is not furnished.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a standard Vanuatu International Company carrying on lawful offshore commercial activities; audit is mandatory only if the company obtains a VFSC license (e.g., banking, insurance, or securities).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or any internationally recognized accounting framework; Vanuatu does not mandate local GAAP for exempt International Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must, at least annually, confirm through its registered agent that its Beneficial Ownership Register accurately reflects all shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners, including any share transfers executed during the year; the agent records the confirmation date and preserves the file for VFSC inspection.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700 – 1,500 per annum depending on volume and responsiveness
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – 5,000 (only if voluntarily audited or if the entity later becomes licensed)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; International Companies (ICs) registered under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] are expressly tax-exempt on worldwide income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero-tax regime extends to capital gains, dividends, royalties and interest; VAT of 12.5% (Value Added Tax Act No. 6 of 2018) applies only to domestic supplies of goods and services in Vanuatu and is not chargeable on offshore export sales of OEM radiology hardware; no payroll tax or social security contribution burden applies to non-resident offshore payroll.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists. Annual Return (AR) under s. 98 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], filed by the registered agent on the VFSC i-Registry Online (IRO) portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within one calendar month following each anniversary of incorporation (not a fiscal year-end rule; no fiscal year concept is set by the Act).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered company name, VFSC registration number, date of incorporation, registered agent and registered office address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Agent must verify and record the non-resident status; non-resident ownership is unrestricted and need not be disclosed in the public registry, but beneficial ownership particulars must be lodged privately with the VFSC per the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2020.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, addresses, nationality and dates of appointment of each director and the corporate secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and secretary are permissible; no residency quota applies to an IC, but the registered agent must confirm identity documents under AML/CFT due diligence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, number of shares issued, classes of shares and consideration received.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bearer shares are prohibited under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2020; all beneficial owners must be disclosed to the VFSC through the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has complied with the Act, maintains its registered office and agent, and has not contravened conduct restrictions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors must personally authorise the declaration; false declarations expose directors to personal criminal liability and strike-off proceedings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Optional memorandum update describing the ISIC 3250 manufacturing activity, licence reference (VFSC medical device trade permit) and expected export jurisdictions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Used to evidence commercial substance if the IC later requires a Vanuatu tax residence certificate for foreign banking; keep factual and aligned with the approved business plan.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers the VFSC graduated arrears penalty on the annual registration fee; non-filing for six consecutive months results in automatic strike-off under s. 101 of the Act, with restoration requiring VFSC consent and payment of all unpaid fees plus a restoration surcharge. Officers and the registered agent may additionally be prosecuted for non-compliance; fines are set at the VFSC/Supreme Court's discretion.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Value Added Tax Return (VAT 100), lodged electronically on the Vanuatu Government Services (VGS) portal under the Value Added Tax Act No. 6 of 2018.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly or quarterly depending on the VAT cycle assigned by the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and payment due by the last day of the month following the end of the VAT accounting period; a pure offshore IC manufacturing and exporting X-ray detectors with no local supplies is not registrable for VAT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of Vanuatu local taxable supplies at 12.5%; export sales of physical detectors are zero-rated but only if the supplier is VAT-registered.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An offshore IC with no local establishment is outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT; if inadvertently registered, the return must report only local supplies and claim input credits for local purchases.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Supplies falling within the exemption schedule (e.g., certain medical goods if sold locally).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exemptions are not applicable to export-only traders; medical-device exemptions require a formal VRCA advance ruling.
If no local supplies, output VAT is nil; no VAT is chargeable on SWIFT LC or wire-export transactions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Recoverable VAT on local purchases such as professional fees, telecommunications and local logistics.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Input VAT recovery is available to registered persons incurring costs in Vanuatu; invoices must contain the IC's name and VU VAT number where relevant.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Output VAT less Input VAT; negative balances are refundable under the VAT Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offshore ICs normally remain outside the VAT net and need not complete this return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and/or late payment attract a monthly interest surcharge of 1.5% on the outstanding amount; deliberate evasion or false returns constitute an offence under the VAT Act punishable by a fine up to three times the evaded amount and imprisonment up to 12 years, with directors and officers jointly and severally liable.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax; an IC may declare and pay dividends to non-resident shareholders free of source tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreements and no treaty network requiring a TRC or treaty-clearance application. Shareholders seeking relief abroad must instead obtain a Residence Certificate from the Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury confirming tax-exempt status; the certificate is issued within 5 business days on written application and is valid for the calendar year only.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic rates: 0% withholding tax on royalties and 0% on debt interest paid by an IC; no treaty rates exist since Vanuatu has no in-force DTA network. Third-party lenders invoicing from overseas receive gross interest; IP licence fees for patented cesium-iodide panel technology can be paid gross, subject to economic-substance review if the IP is held by the IC.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing statute, no thin-capitalisation rules, and no Local File/Master File thresholds. Controlled-transaction pricing is not reviewable under domestic tax law; however, foreign revenue authorities may re-characterise inter-company pricing of the OEM hardware, so contemporaneous OECD-aligned documentation is recommended to protect the customer's cross-border deductions.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Comparable Uncontrolled Price (CUP) for OEM hardware sales and IP royalties
Resale Price Method (RPM) for distribution legs
Cost Plus Method (CPM) for contract manufacturing
Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM) for routine low-risk functions
Profit Split Method (PSM) for integrated high-IP supply chains
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations Act No. 22 of 2019 — manufacturing of tangible X-ray flat-panel detectors is not a listed 'relevant activity'; targeted categories that may capture the group's income include 'IP business' (if the IC owns, licences or commercially exploits patents/trade secrets) and 'distribution and service centre' (if the IC takes procurement or warehousing functions). To remain compliant, the IC must demonstrate in Vanuatu a physical office, at least one locally engaged director or manager, board meetings held in Vanuatu at least twice per financial year, and proportionate core-income-generating expenditure. Substantial fines and strike-off exposure arise only if the IC in fact performs a relevant activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the VU IC to fabricate an artificial supply chain for digital detectors, issuing false e-invoices, or misrepresenting export origin to avoid customs duty, VAT or foreign income taxes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution under the Penal Code [Cap. 135] for fraud (imprisonment up to 12 years) and under the VAT Act for evasion (fine up to three times any evaded VAT); civil penalty assessments by the VRCA; disqualification of the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and de facto controllers are criminally liable where they knew or ought to have known of the false invoicing; personal civil restitution is recoverable by the VRCA; travel bans may be imposed pending extradition or asset-freezing orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC purely as a nominee shell with no registered office, agent instructions, board activity or business records while routing OEM payments through Vanuatu to disguise beneficial ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC administrative strike-off under s. 101 of the International Companies Act; ESR penalties up to VUV 2,000,000 per relevant activity for entities caught by the 2019 regime; restoration refused without filing of nil returns and agent confirmation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors face fines for false declarations; courts may pierce the veil to impose restitution on the ultimate beneficial owner; directors may be barred from managing any Vanuatu company for up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / CFT Breach (Beneficial Ownership and STR)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file suspicious transaction reports, concealing beneficial ownership of the detector-trading IC despite the 2020 beneficial ownership amendments, or processing SWIFT LC funds through prohibited counterparties or sanctioned countries.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Enforcement by the Vanuatu FIU under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 7 of 2014: administrative penalties up to VUV 20,000,000 for body corporates and imprisonment for individuals up to 15 years; asset-confiscation orders under the Proceeds of Crime Act [Cap. 279].
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly omit an STR or authorise a sanctions-listed wire transfer incur personal criminal liability; the VFSC may delegate the beneficial-ownership register to the agent and freeze directors' travel through court order.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing a false annual return, false solvency declaration, false director or ownership particulars, or forged residence certificate documents with the VFSC or a foreign bank.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal liability under the International Companies Act for false statements (fine within the VFSC discretionary band and imprisonment up to 2 years); in aggravated cross-border fraud, charges escalate to Penal Code [Cap. 135] fraud offences (imprisonment up to 12 years); restoration of a struck-off IC is denied.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers who signed the false declaration are personally prosecuted even after resignation; they are jointly and severally liable for third-party losses, with civil restitution and punitive costs recoverable.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Manufacturing, importing or exporting digital X-ray flat-panel detectors without the required VFSC trade permit or medical-device authorisation and without Ministry of Health product notification for shipments to regulated end-markets (e.g., EU MDR, US FDA).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Refusal of export permits, seizure of goods by customs, fines under the relevant trade licensing regulations, and cancellation of the IC's registration; foreign regulators will also block imports of non-conforming devices under CE/FDA regimes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed product technical files or import-export declarations are personally liable for false conformity statements; penalties include director disqualification, personal civil damages for end-user harm, and travel restrictions in enforcement actions.
